clusters.headline: Indonesian Police Dismiss General Eko Hadi Over Illegal Wiretapping
aiSummaryBullets: Irjen Eko Hadi Santoso was dishonorably discharged from the Indonesian National Police following an ethics committee decision.
The officer was found to have conspired to conduct illegal wiretapping using official law enforcement technology and resources.

clusters.headline: Government Clarifies Mining Status And Rhino Relocation In Ujung Kulon
aiSummaryBullets: The Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources maintains that no mining permits have been issued for the Ujung Kulon National Park area.
Central government officials state that any decision regarding the relocation of Javan Rhinos will be based on comprehensive scientific studies.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Expected To Submit Vice Presidential Nominees
aiSummaryBullets: Coordinating Minister Yusril Ihza Mahendra confirmed that President Prabowo must propose two vice presidential candidates by November 25.
Gerindra party officials indicated that the President will finalize the selection process after returning from his current overseas trip.

clusters.headline: Sufmi Dasco Ahmad Gains Growing Support For Vice Presidency Role
aiSummaryBullets: Regional chapters of the Gerindra party and local community organizations have publicly declared support for Sufmi Dasco Ahmad as a vice presidential candidate.
Supporters cite his ability to bridge communication between political parties and his commitment to maintaining government stability as key qualifications.

clusters.headline: Indonesia U-17 Qualifies For 2027 AFC Asian Cup After Afghanistan Win
aiSummaryBullets: Indonesia U-17 defeated Afghanistan 4-0 to officially qualify for the 2027 AFC U-17 Asian Cup tournament.
Head coach David Nascimento publicly addressed the squad's mental performance during the first half of the match.

clusters.headline: Government Confirms People School Will Not Use UI City Forest
aiSummaryBullets: The Minister of Social Affairs stated the School for the People project will not utilize land located in the University of Indonesia city forest.
The Governor of Jakarta formally opposed using the forest area for school construction, suggesting alternative sites in West and East Jakarta.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Police Continue Probe Into Illegal Wiretapping Of President
aiSummaryBullets: Brigadier General TK remains in special confinement as investigators probe their role in the unauthorized surveillance of President Prabowo Subianto.
The National Police Commission reported that an official identified as EHS has expressed regret following dismissal related to the wiretapping investigation.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Broadens Strategic International Partnerships
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto initiated potential collaborations with South Korea focused on critical mineral downstreaming and semiconductor manufacturing.
The Indonesian government is exploring opportunities with Japan regarding the development and processing of rare earth metals.

clusters.headline: Prabowo Discusses Energy And Regional Cooperation At ASEAN Summit
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto highlighted Indonesia's commitment to energy independence by promoting B50 fuel and large-scale solar power projects.
The summit sessions included the ASEAN-Japan meeting and the East Asia Summit, where Prabowo emphasized international issues including Palestinian independence.

clusters.headline: Polda NTT Secures Forensic Results In Kupang Regent Rape Case
aiSummaryBullets: Police have officially received forensic evidence regarding the sexual assault allegations involving the Kupang Regent.
The regional governor and other officials have expressed support for a transparent, non-interventional investigation process.

clusters.headline: Government Distributes Aid As Flooding Persists Across Aceh Region
aiSummaryBullets: Over 21,000 residents in Aceh have been affected by recent flooding, with national disaster agencies coordinating relief efforts.
The government has begun distributing aid, including assistance for thousands of small businesses impacted by the ongoing inundation.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Police Investigate Treason Link In Illegal Surveillance
aiSummaryBullets: Indonesian police have upgraded the probe into the illegal surveillance of President Prabowo Subianto to the investigation stage.
Coordinating Minister Yusril Ihza Mahendra stated that investigators have identified connections between the surveillance and alleged treason.

clusters.headline: Government Intensifies Food Security Efforts And Price Stability
aiSummaryBullets: The Coordinating Ministry for Food is promoting the diversification of local food consumption to boost national food resilience.
Regional inflation control teams are urged to collaborate with state institutions to maintain price stability.

clusters.headline: Indonesian House Accelerates Legislative Bills Including Wiretapping
aiSummaryBullets: Commission III of the Indonesian House of Representatives aims to finalize the Wiretapping Bill by the end of 2026.
The legislative body has officially adopted the Bill on the Procedures for Law Formation as a House initiative.

clusters.headline: KPK Expands Corruption Probes Involving Regional And Agency Officials
aiSummaryBullets: KPK officials are questioning 18 Klaten government staff regarding graft allegations involving the local regent and project procurement.
Internal investigations are underway regarding allegations that KPK staff leaked sensitive documents related to the ATR/BPN bribery case.

clusters.headline: Shin Tae-yong Praises Performance Of Arlyansyah Abdulmanan
aiSummaryBullets: Coach Shin Tae-yong described Arlyansyah Abdulmanan as a valuable asset for the future following his goal against Bali United.
The national team coach has been managing player fitness for Persija Jakarta amidst a demanding match schedule.

clusters.headline: Police Dismiss Inspector General Eko Hadi Over Illegal Surveillance
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesian National Police Code of Ethics Commission dismissed Inspector General Eko Hadi Santoso.
The disciplinary action follows investigations into allegations of illegal surveillance involving the President.

clusters.headline: Satgas PRR Dampingi Menko PMK Tinjau Banjir Susulan di Subulussalam Aceh
aiSummaryBullets: Detik reports: Satgas PRR Dampingi Menko PMK Tinjau Banjir Susulan di Subulussalam Aceh
VIVA reports: Dampingi Menko PMK, Satgas PRR Tinjau Banjir dan Kunjungi Pengungsi di Subulussalam

clusters.headline: Witness Details Nominee Accounts In Silmy Karim Corruption Trial
aiSummaryBullets: A witness testified to creating three nominee accounts to manage unofficial funds related to foreign national residence permits.
The witness reported regular payments ranging from 80 to 130 million rupiah during the legal proceedings.

clusters.headline: Tensions Rise As Iran Targets US Facilities And Drone Operations
aiSummaryBullets: Iranian forces reported shooting down an Israeli-made drone identified within their sovereign airspace.
Intelligence reports regarding potential radioactive threats in Washington were dismissed as illegitimate by Iranian authorities.
